journey.name: new profile after wallet wipe
journey.description: Precondition: a disposable, unfunded test wallet with Paykit enabled and a Bitkit-created Pubky profile and no available Pubky Ring identities. Use a reachable Pubky test network and an English device. This deletes the wallet and its profile credentials. Keep the app process alive throughout the journey.

actions.action: Open Profile from the Home header and record the current public Pubky key
Return Home and leave the app active for at least 10 seconds so background Paykit work can run
Open Settings, select Security, and open Reset wallet (identifier "ResetAndRestore")
Tap Reset Wallet and confirm the reset
Wait for reset to finish and verify wallet onboarding is visible
Accept the terms, skip the introduction, and create a new wallet
Wait for Home, then open Profile from the header
Continue through the profile introduction and select Create Profile (identifier "PubkyChoiceCreate")
Enter "After Wipe" in the username field (identifier "CreateProfileUsername") and dismiss the keyboard
Tap Continue (identifier "CreateProfileSave") and wait for profile creation to finish
Open Profile and verify it shows "After Wipe" and a public Pubky key different from the deleted identity
Return Home and reopen Profile; verify the new profile is still available without restarting the app
